_about: Issue #628: rows another pull request is adding (#625) and that are not on main yet. The allowlist and the dashboards may name a row only when it is in code or here. Fields come from the branch's code (set A) or from the issue's spec (set B, no branch pushed when this was written). Remove an entry once its row is on main; kit.py --check reports entries that are. Entries left on main are rows the scanner (rows.py) can't read yet.

BG_POPULATION.frequency: every 5 min, one per battleground and realm (about 144 an hour)
BG_POPULATION.meaning: Bots present per battleground and realm, by goal, beside the expected headcount (#610).
BG_POPULATION.note: On main, but rows.py can't read its Format (StringBuilder or interpolated LivingRows formatter) yet; fields copied from the code.

CAST_INTERRUPT.frequency: every 10th cast an attacker's interrupt timer reached, at most 20 a minute
CAST_INTERRUPT.meaning: A sampled cast an interrupting hit reached: caster kind, spell type, time left, kept or lost (#596).
CAST_INTERRUPT.note: On main, but rows.py can't read its Format (StringBuilder or interpolated LivingRows formatter) yet; fields copied from the code.

BG_TARGET_PICK.frequency: every 10th battleground pick, at most 10 a minute
BG_TARGET_PICK.meaning: A sampled battleground target pick: the kind picked, controlled enemies and engines skipped, rally board or not (#621).
BG_TARGET_PICK.note: On main, but rows.py can't read its Format (StringBuilder or interpolated LivingRows formatter) yet; fields copied from the code.
